market.question: Who will finish higher: Verstappen or Russell?

assessment.reasoning: Russell is co-favorite to win at +150 odds while Verstappen is +3500 longshot for Miami. Russell has been on poles all season; Mercedes dominant in 2026. Verstappen has lone Saudi win. H2H probability for Verstappen finishing ahead is roughly 0.25-0.30. Market 0.265 looks fair.
assessment.key_uncertainty: DNF probability and race-day setup advantage
